name: svartalfar_settler
description: a Svartalfar Settler (Fall from Heaven), a dark elf: pale lavender-grey skin, long white hair, long pointed ears, a purple coat with black sleeves and silver trim, a grey steel plate on the screen-left shoulder, a brown belt with a silver buckle and a brown pouch, black trousers and black boots with silver bands, a huge tan leather backpack on the back (on the screen-left side) topped with a rolled purple bedroll, a steel cooking pot hanging from its side, and a tall dark crook-topped walking staff in the LEFT hand (screen-right)
hands: the crook-topped walking staff stays upright in the left hand on the screen-right side and the right hand on the screen-left side grips the backpack strap at the chest as an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the walking staff is lifted up over the head with its crook top pointing up and back, the big backpack on the back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the walking staff cocked behind the head with its crook top hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in at the backpack strap
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the walking staff is level, its crook top pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: staff arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the crook top of the walking staff smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the walking staff carries on down until its crook top nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, white hair trailing back, the backpack and its cooking pot swinging
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the walking staff lifts back toward its upright ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out with the walking staff tilted up)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the walking staff dipping, the empty right fist still held out, the heavy backpack pulling back

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the walking staff high, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the walking staff lowering, the heavy backpack dragging at the shoulders
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crook top of the walking staff resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left onto the big backpack, the walking staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on the back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the big backpack under the shoulders; the walking staff lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the purple bedroll and the cooking pot settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on the back over the backpack, eyes closed, white hair spread out, the walking staff on the ground beside the body
